description: This file defines a Java interface for a builder that creates instances of JsonFieldSelector, providing a fluent API for constructing JSON field selectors using various methods to add or remove JSON pointers, string representations, and field definitions.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds JSON pointer(s) to the field selector to be built, accepting a nullable JsonPointer and additional pointers.

methods.name: addPointers
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers to the field selector from an iterable.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds JSON pointer(s) from string representation(s) to the field selector, accepting a nullable string and further strings.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointer strings from an iterable to the field selector.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds JSON pointer(s) derived from field definition(s) to the selector, accepting nullable and variable arguments.

methods.name: addFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers from an iterable of field definitions.

methods.name: addFieldSelector
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers from another JsonFieldSelector to the builder.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds JSON pointers to the selector by parsing a string with specified options, potentially throwing exceptions on parsing errors.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Parses a string to add JSON pointers to the selector, without URL-encoding.

methods.name: removePointer
methods.description: Removes a specific JSON pointer from the builder.

methods.name: removePointers
methods.description: Removes multiple JSON pointers from the builder.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a JSON pointer identified by its string representation.

methods.name: removePointerStrings
methods.description: Removes multiple JSON pointers identified by their string representations.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinition
methods.description: Removes a field based on its definition from the builder.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Removes multiple field definitions from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JsonFieldSelector instance containing all added pointers and definitions.
